description: Mark emails as spam or not spam the way Thunderbird's Junk button does: train Thunderbird's adaptive junk filter and set the user's junk status (messages.update only sets the status; the filter doesn't learn).

functions.name: guesses
functions.description: Of these emails, the ones whose junk mark is only the adaptive junk filter's guess (not the user's verdict, a filter rule or the server's flag).

functions.name: classify
functions.description: Train the junk filter with the user's verdict ('spam', 'good', or 'unknown' to take a verdict back) and set each email's junk status. Returns { trained, updated, missing }.
